sourceRole: Original full-bleed material atlas, four projection views
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original 2 by 2 cloud material texture atlas for projection onto a real 3D cumulus shell in an anime flight-game prototype. This is a technical texture asset, NOT a scene illustration or concept screenshot.
Output: square high-resolution image; four exactly equal square quadrants, no gutters, borders, text, labels, frames, horizon, sky, landscape, aircraft or characters. Every quadrant is fully covered by painted cloud material; no transparency.
Art direction: exquisite original Japanese theatrical animation background painting, delicate opaque gouache and watercolor-like scumbling, poetic late-afternoon luminosity, readable large asymmetric masses with exquisite fine edge strokes and blue-violet recesses. Match an airy blue R2 sky with restrained peach-gold light. Not copied from any film. Not toon shading, not CG, not pillow or marshmallow balls, no black outlines, no plastic or repeated rounded blobs.
Top-left quadrant: close side-facing cumulus wall material, broad irregular rising cloud ridges, ivory sunlit upper shelves and lavender-blue shaded lower folds, horizontal painterly structure with varied scale.
Top-right quadrant: cloud tops viewed from above, expansive layered sea of clouds, intricate connected long ridges and sunwashed ivory terraces, very subtle warm gold and blue violet channels, filled edge to edge.
Bottom-left quadrant: underside material, wide flat yet irregular diffuse cloud base, luminous cool blue lavender shadows and gentle broken soft striations, no dark storm drama, large quiet masses with delicate local wisps, filled edge to edge.
Bottom-right quadrant: close backlit side material, pale ivory cloud face with restrained peach-gold feathery filaments along irregular ridges and cool periwinkle hollows, not orange sunset all over.
Lighting must be subtle enough for additional world-space sunlight modulation; do not paint a sun disc or cast-directional black shadows. Full-bleed painted cloud material throughout all four squares. Original artwork only.
notes: Original AI-generated artwork created for this project; no film still, character or third-party background was supplied or copied. Runtime derivative is only resizing/padding/WebP encoding. No exclusive-copyright warranty is claimed.
